content: vitest 5.0.0 (+ @vitest/coverage-v8 5.0.0) requires node >=22.12. No official Expo RN runner; for pure-JS services/repositories (BabyLog architecture) run vitest in node environment with DI-mocked DbAdapter; better-sqlite3 13.0.3 in-memory for repo integration tests. jest-expo 57.0.5 is the Expo-official alternative if component tests needed later.
